requirements_sections.4: Project Safety deadline October 7, 23:00 UTC+8; submissions cannot be made after the form closes.
requirements_sections.7: The form must describe actual work. If the project falls outside the described work, contact safety@igem.org.

safety_activity.official_change_process: Only if actual work falls outside the described/approved scope or official reviewers request corrections, contact the safety committee for correction/reopening or supplemental information; acceptance is not guaranteed. No change is required solely because the plan was written in future tense.

check_in_verification.method: Read-only CUA inspection of official Form and Activity; no download, edit, or submission

scope: Contained designated laboratory work by trained researchers under supervision
No pathogens, gene drives, environmental release, or public demonstrations
drosophila.condition_note: No additional condition or comment was visible in the inspected Activity; this does not assert anything about uninspected records.

policy_review.method: Read-only web retrieval of official pages and their public page-content modules; no browser session used or files downloaded
policy_review.white_list: The current organism list does not explicitly include Drosophila. Other multicellular organisms including insects and primary isolated cells require Check-in approval. The verified Drosophila Check-in is the relevant approval evidence.
policy_review.animal_use: The Animal Use page exempts experiments with lower-order invertebrates (mosquitoes given as an example) from the additional Animal Use Form while still requiring Check-in. Drosophila, brain dissection and calcium imaging are not individually named. Do not automatically treat the Animal Use No Submissions status as noncompliance for the fly work; interpret applicable scope and any committee conditions.
policy_review.advance_application: Describing intended experiments in future tense is consistent with applying before work; actual work outside the described scope, not future tense itself, is the condition requiring clarification.
